content: Fioricet and Esgic are brand-name medications that consist of a combination of acetaminophen (325 mg), butalbital (a barbiturate, 50 mg), and caffeine (40 mg). These drugs are specifically indicated for the treatment of tension headaches and muscle contraction headaches. Although not officially approved for this purpose, they are frequently used off-label to manage migraines and other pain-related conditions. Usage and Dosage Fioricet is prescribed for the treatment of complex headaches and muscle contraction headaches. It is also commonly used to treat migraines, despite not being FDA-approved for this indication. The standard adult dosage is 1 to 2 tablets every four hours as needed, with a maximum limit of six tablets within a 24-hour period. Mechanism of Action Butalbital exerts a generalized depressant effect on the central nervous system and, at very high doses, can also have peripheral effects. Acetaminophen provides analgesic (pain-relieving) and antipyretic (fever-reducing) effects, which are thought to be mediated through the inhibition of the prostaglandin synthetase enzyme complex. Caffeine is believed to work by causing constriction of cerebral blood vessels. The half-life of butalbital is approximately 35 hours, though this can be prolonged in cases of liver damage or overdose. Caffeine has a half-life of about 3 hours. Side Effects The side effects of any medication can vary, but commonly reported adverse effects of Fioricet include: Dizziness Drowsiness A feeling of intoxication Light-headedness Nausea Vomiting Sedation Addiction potential Shortness of breath Abdominal pain Variations Phrenilin is a similar combination of butalbital and acetaminophen but does not contain caffeine (325 mg/50 mg). Esgic Plus and Phrenilin Forte contain higher doses of acetaminophen, with 500 mg and 650 mg respectively, instead of the standard 325 mg. Esgic Plus also includes 40 mg of caffeine. Fiorinal contains aspirin instead of acetaminophen. Fiorinal and Fioricet are also available in formulations that include codeine, known as Fiorinal with Codeine and Fioricet with Codeine. These versions add 30 mg of codeine phosphate to the mixture.
